comment: Every API route must enter an approved auth boundary OR appear here. Categories are MEASURED by scripts/auth-boundary-harness.ts; the REASONS are written by a person. Owner ruling 2026-08-19: intentionally public or system routes are explicitly allowlisted, never merely counted as exceptions.

public.reason: Ending a session cannot require a valid session. Gating logout behind the caller gateway would mean a user whose session is already broken -- the case where signing out matters most -- has no way to clear it. It destroys credentials and creates nothing.

The OAuth START route, reached before any session exists by definition. It is not unchecked: the provider must be in the code's own closed list, enabled in NEXT_PUBLIC_OAUTH_PROVIDERS, and ON at GoTrue read live from its public settings; `next` passes through safeNextPath, and an unreadable settings response refuses rather than proceeding. Verified in sso-harness (18/0).

The platform's published visual constants -- hex values, spacing, type scale. Public and unauthenticated on purpose, stated in the file's own header. They are already in every stylesheet the browser downloads; gating them would protect nothing and break the design-token consumers.

The patient-facing booking surface. Unauthenticated BY DESIGN and deliberately outside the (shell) group: a patient is not a practitioner, and routing this through the practice gateway would mean the only session it understood was a practitioner's. It names no practice, so a stranger guessing the URL learns nothing about who is on the platform.

system.reason: A system route with no human caller, invoked by the scheduler. Not ungated: it requires `Authorization: Bearer ${CRON_SECRET}` and returns 401 without it -- and 503 rather than running when CRON_SECRET is unset, so a missing secret fails closed instead of leaving the job open.

A system route with no human caller, invoked by the scheduler. Not ungated: it requires `Authorization: Bearer ${CRON_SECRET}` and returns 401 without it -- and 503 rather than running when CRON_SECRET is unset, so a missing secret fails closed instead of leaving the job open.

A system route with no human caller, invoked by Flutterwave after a payment. It cannot enter the caller gateway because the gateway has no Competen session -- and it is the ONLY unauthenticated write path in the Practice API, which is exactly why it belongs here with a reason rather than merely counted. Not ungated: it checks the verif-hash header against FLW_SECRET_HASH in constant time BEFORE parsing the body, returns 401 without a match, and 503 rather than proceeding when the secret is unset, so a missing secret fails closed. And the body is never trusted as evidence of payment: the engine verifies server-to-server against Flutterwave and compares the result to the amount WE recorded before the practitioner left (subscription.ts applyWebhook). A forged request that passes the signature still grants nothing.
